purpose: Explicitly enabled local task listener for bounded writer jobs. The Mesh server remains a coordination journal; no central scheduler or existing conversation wakeup is added.

policy.connector_config: absolute private native connector config path; binds origin, agent, project, runtime, workspace and key/CA
policy.channel_id: one explicitly configured writable connector channel
policy.state_dir: absolute private owned directory outside the workspace; separate from native connector state
policy.allowed_creators: 1..32 distinct task creator account IDs preauthorized by the local operator
policy.allowed_files: 1..32 exact relative file paths, excluding .git and traversal; new files are permitted, deletion is not
policy.workspace_pins: complete initial bounded workspace map of relative file paths to lowercase SHA256; .git worktree pointer may be pinned but never edited; empty workspace map is permitted
policy.base_revision: operator-pinned source baseline identifier; evolving context recorded separately in evidence
policy.prompt: 1..16000 UTF-8 bytes of local execution instructions; remote task fields cannot override local policy
policy.max_jobs: integer 1..100, durable lifetime cap for this immutable policy/journal
policy.max_run_seconds: integer 30..3600 per listener invocation and per coordination job; provider timeout clamped to remaining invocation budget
policy.publish_artifacts: must be true; explicitly authorizes publishing exact scoped files and sanitized result evidence to project readers
policy.request_review: boolean; true publishes review_requested with the exact complete artifact set

selection: Only ready Tasks assigned to this authenticated agent, created by a locally allowed creator, with exact scope contained in allowed_files. Messages, replies, broadcasts and remote runtime commands are never execution triggers. Generated plans are validated before run_started; oversized task context is reported as rejected and left ready.
dispatch: Verify current identity, writable project/task and configured channel access. Take a cooperative exclusive flock on the canonical workspace directory inode. Persist a stable run ID and CAS run_started payload before POST. After an exact receipt, the existing CoordinationWorker revalidates current run, role, task state and scope before one bounded fresh CLI invocation.

durability.state: Private SQLite WAL journals with FULL synchronous commits; policy and API identity bound independently of rotatable credentials
durability.workspace: Linux user.agent_mesh_listener xattr binds workspace to the immutable policy/journal and retains active-run taint. Alternative journals/policies or an unresolved marker without matching durable job are refused. Child inherits the locked directory FD to preserve cooperative exclusion after abrupt parent exit.
durability.replay: Lost acknowledgements replay identical event/artifact publication IDs and bytes. Never automatically repeat an uncertain model dispatch. Uncertain/blocked jobs block the whole listener queue pending explicit operator inspection.
durability.success: Freeze exact file bundle and sanitized evidence bytes before upload; reuse existing artifact validation and CoordinationWorker durable artifacts_ready outbox. Optional review_requested hands the full set to the assigned independent reviewer. Listener phase done means handoff published, not task completion.
durability.evidence: Client-reported result, immutable policy source baseline, canonical full baseline/result workspace SHA256 fingerprints, prior handoff task/run/artifact dependencies, and independent_verification=not_performed. Raw prompts, logs and provider output remain private.
durability.next_task: Advance the durable full workspace pins only after successful handoff; reject unexplained external changes before later writers.
durability.conflicts: Do not refresh a frozen publication's expected_version after CAS conflict. Cancellation/revocation prevents subsequent authorized publication; an already running external process is not server-fenced. Partial local work remains for inspection without automatic rollback.

commands.check: Read-only local policy and API identity/channel/task-ACL preflight; initial workspace mismatch is failure; no model or journal writes
commands.status: Read existing private local journal without locking the active workspace; missing journal yields initialized:false and jobs:[]
commands.run: Requires --allow-model; bounded polling and execution. --once performs one polling/dispatch or durable retry pass. No reboot autostart is installed.

limits: Linux filesystem with flock and user xattr support; cooperation does not sandbox arbitrary external writers.
Existing bounded worker workspace limits apply: 4096 files, 128 MiB total, no symlinks or .git directory; exported directory or worktree pointer only.
Generated worker plan maximum prompt is 32000 UTF-8 bytes. Unsupported oversized task context is not silently truncated.

Portable handoff requires every scoped file to exist after execution, at most 32 files and 2 MiB encoded bundle. No automatic apply/merge/deploy, test verification, independent reviewer execution, completion claim or uncertain recovery.
A truncated task listing is a visible error; this listener is not an unbounded fleet queue.
Network retries are bounded by the invocation; pending durable publications remain available to a later explicit invocation.
